_about: Which release each commit-pinned source in migration/source-review-notes.json belongs to, for the "Checked against <release>" chip (src/components/PageTitle.astro). A key is owner/repo@<40-character commit>. Each entry names the release tag whose commit is exactly that commit; evidence is the GitHub API ref of that tag, and resolved records what the API returned when it was checked, so nothing is read from the notes' prose. scripts/lib/pinned-releases.mjs fails the build when a note pins a commit that has no entry here, or when an entry's tag does not resolve to its own commit. To add an entry for a new pin: gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/tags/<tag>, follow an annotated tag with gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/tags/<object sha>, and compare the commit with the pin. A commit that is not a release's tagged commit gets no entry and no chip. showCheckedAgainst is the switch for the chip: false until the maintainers decide the wording.
